vision.title: Holistic transformation for an authentic and lasting revival in the nations
vision.lead1: Born in July 2023 out of a retreat with the youth of Chrisco (Goma district), METAMORPHOO is carried by Pastor – Entrepreneur – Worship leader Fidèle BUMBA OBUTU and his wife Clarice BUMBA. The movement is confirmed by prophetic words and fuelled by the vision of the Chrisco work: the awakening of the Church that will impact nations and governments.
vision.lead2: Metamorphoo is not a church, but a movement of the Holy Spirit for the nations. It is a missionary platform that can give birth to churches.
vision.cardText: “Do not conform to the pattern of this world…” The founding text of the movement.

mission.title: Train, equip and activate believers
mission.subtitle: Every action is contextualised according to the specific revival needs: families, churches, communities, cities, nations, professional, intellectual and entrepreneurial spheres.

metamorphose.title: From caterpillar to butterfly
metamorphose.lead: Metamorphosis is not an improvement: it is a total transformation. It is the image God gives us in Romans 12:2, and the very reason METAMORPHOO exists.

stages.texte: Like the caterpillar, a person can crawl, limited by an unrenewed mind: spiritual, moral and intellectual sleep. Metamorphoo begins with an honest diagnosis of that state.
In the secret of the chrysalis, everything is rebuilt. Training, laying on of hands, the Word, repentance and sacrifice: the time when God shapes the vessel before using it.
The butterfly no longer crawls: it flies and it pollinates. The transformed believer becomes an agent of revival in family, church, profession and nation.

objectif.title: Trigger a holistic revival
objectif.subtitle: A revival that leaves no area untouched: from our relationship with God to our impact on the nations.

origin.title: How METAMORPHOO was born
origin.subtitle: A movement of the Holy Spirit for the nations, born out of an encounter with God and confirmed by prophetic voices.

timeline.texte: During a retreat held with the youth of Chrisco (Goma district), Pastor – Entrepreneur – Worship leader Fidèle BUMBA OBUTU and his wife Clarice BUMBA received from God the inspiration for METAMORPHOO.
“Be transformed by the renewing of your mind.” Metamorphosis becomes the DNA, the name and the method of the movement.
The movement is confirmed by prophetic words from Apostle Hary Das (in his lifetime) and from several patriarchs around the world.

timeline.titre: The vision of the Chrisco work
timeline.texte: Fuelled by the vision of the Chrisco work explained in point 4 by Apostle Samuel Emmanuel Dikanakina: the awakening of the Church that will impact nations and governments.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.subtitle: Publisher, hosting, intellectual property and terms of use of the site.
legal.privacySubtitle: What data we collect, why, and how to delete it.

contenu: Metamorphoo is a non-profit Christian organisation. Metamorphoo is not a church, but a movement of the Holy Spirit for the nations and a missionary platform.

The site is hosted on a professional web hosting platform (Vercel, Netlify or equivalent) and its source code is published on GitHub. Form data is hosted by Google (Google Forms / Google Sheets) as part of the free Google Workspace offering.

The name METAMORPHOO, the logo, texts, visuals and illustrations are the property of the movement. Any reproduction without written authorisation is prohibited. Bible quotations are taken from the Louis Segond translation (public domain).
Gifts, offerings, tithes and vows are free and without commercial consideration. Metamorphoo sells no product or service. Supporting partnerships are the subject of a written agreement.
For any question about this website:
We only collect the information you voluntarily send us: name, email, phone, city, message, type of support and gift amount.
No banking data is stored on this site. Online payments are processed by the authorised platforms (FlexPaie, GeneraPay, Mobile Money operators).
Your data is used to contact you again, organise activities, track applications and training, thank you for your support and send you the newsletter if you have consented.
Form responses are recorded in a secure Google Sheets spreadsheet, accessible only to the authorised team. They are kept for as long as necessary for the purpose of the processing, then deleted.
You may request access to, correction or deletion of your data at any time by writing to our email address. We reply within 30 days.
This site uses no advertising cookies. Embedded content (YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Google Maps) may place its own cookies when you view it.
The site is served over a secure connection (HTTPS). Access to data is limited to authorised members of the movement.

faq.question: Is Metamorphoo a church?
faq.reponse: No. Metamorphoo is not a church, but a movement of the Holy Spirit for the nations. It is a missionary platform that can give birth to churches. We work in partnership with local churches and guide newcomers without a church home to a local church.

faq.question: How do I join the movement?
faq.reponse: Fill in the “Newcomer” form on the Contact page or write to us on WhatsApp at +243 997 628 592. You will be registered, automatically followed up by our team, then integrated into a core group or guided according to your situation.

faq.question: Who can become a key leader?
faq.reponse: One single criterion: to carry the burden of revival and be ready to sacrifice to accomplish it. Leaders come from different churches and professional spheres, and organise Metamorphoo actions in their area under the guidance of the visionaries.

faq.question: How does the online training work?
faq.reponse: The Metamorphoo Academy offers YouTube video modules to follow at your own pace. Your progress is recorded. At the end of the track you validate your application: you are then called online or in person for a validation interview.

faq.question: How can I support financially?
faq.reponse: By offering, donation, tithe or vow, in cash or in kind, on a one-off, weekly, monthly or yearly basis. Online payments (FlexPaie, GeneraPay) will be activated progressively; in the meantime, Mobile Money, bank transfer and direct handover are available.

faq.question: Are my gifts used transparently?
faq.reponse: Metamorphoo is a non-profit Christian organisation. God remains the primary source of funds. Every gift is allocated to actions, the Triomphes and Oasis of life projects, and is reported to supporting partners.

testimonies.texte: Metamorphoo awakened our youth. In three days of camp we saw more conversions than in a whole year. This is not emotion, it is a transformation that remains.
I learned that revival begins in the way I think. My family, my work and my service have been transformed. Today I lead a core group of 12 leaders in my city.
We support Metamorphoo because the work is serious, transparent and structured. The humanitarian impact of Oasis of life is visible and measurable.
